name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-core
description: LOCAL COMPATIBILITY SHIM (Zoveli). Provides the Zoveli plugin-authoring convention (definePlugin/defineSkill/Tool plus host stubs) so the workspace typechecks, builds, and tests without the upstream harness runtime. This is NOT the upstream DeepSeek Harness core: real Cordis runtime interop (Context.apply, service keys, event map) is future work tracked in docs/adr/001-cordis-plugin-architecture.md.
